name: run_borzoi_calico_sad
description: Score regulatory variants with CALICO'S OWN Borzoi release (borzoi_sad.py at commit 5c93582, fold 0, reverse-complement ensemble) against pinned GRCh38. Returns upstream's four published statistics -- SAD, logSAD, D2, logD2 -- over 6,385 strand-summed human RNA tracks, with the strongest tracks per variant named. This is the paper's method rather than an approximation of it; use run_borzoi_variant_effect (the borzoi-pytorch port, GPU) for a fast central-bin delta from two sequences. CPU-only here: about four minutes per variant, four variants maximum.

variants.description: Single-nucleotide variants to score, at most 4. Each costs about four minutes.

chrom.description: GRCh38 chromosome, with or without the 'chr' prefix.

id.description: Optional identifier, echoed into the output. Defaults to chrom_pos_ref_alt.

top_tracks.description: How many tracks to name per variant, ranked by |SAD|. The full 6,385-track vectors stay in the provider's sad.h5, whose path the reply carries.

variants.description: Per variant: snp, chr, pos, alleles, max_abs_SAD and top_tracks with all four statistics.

sad_h5.description: Path to the sad.h5 stock's own writer produced.
